status: Single-reader classification of recorded first-decision text. Not human annotation, not validated coding, not evidence of internal computation.

categories.explicit: Before the first action, the text names the mortgages that building sales will release (deeds or amount), or a total budget that includes them.
categories.open_check: The text raises the released mortgages as something to check, without a completed total.
categories.omits: The text totals cash, salvage and the mortgages listed on the current menu only, and concludes payment is impossible.

channels.note: applied private note attached to the received tool call (standard prompt)
channels.provider: provider-returned reasoning field of the selected attempt; Opus cases are action-only recovery attempts with no private-note request
